sloka: तौ हन्यमानौ नाराचैर्धाराभिरिव पर्वतौ।हेमपुङ्खान्नरव्याघ्रौ तिग्मान् मुमुचतुः शरान् ।। ६.८०.२९ ।।
transliteration: tau hanyamānau nārācairdhārābhiriva parvatau।hemapuṅkhānnaravyāghrau tigmān mumucatuḥ śarān ।। 6.80.29 ।।

translations.english: The tigers among humans, Rama, and Lakshmana, like two mountains hit by steel arrows, released sharp pointedgold shafted steel arrows and tormented (Indrajith).
